items.name: data-loss-prevention
items.title: Data Loss Prevention
items.description:
-
  Halt before any command that causes irreversible data loss. Require
  explicit user consent. Use when running DROP, TRUNCATE, DELETE without
  WHERE, rm -rf, git reset --hard, or any destructive operation.
items.summary: Halt and confirm before destructive commands

install.agent_prompt: Fetch https://vidoxlabs.dev/vitools/raw/skills/data-loss-prevention.md and install it as a project skill at skills/data-loss-prevention/SKILL.md. Follow its Procedure. Do not modify Guardrails.

items.name: evidence-answering
items.title: Evidence-Governed Answering
items.description:
-
  Ensure responses and decisions are evidence-governed when making claims
  about Vidoxlabs systems. Use when producing conclusions, recommendations,
  or documentation that will be treated as canonical. Require citations,
  links, or artifacts to support each claim.
items.summary: Require evidence for claims about Vidoxlabs systems.

install.agent_prompt: Fetch https://vidoxlabs.dev/vitools/raw/skills/evidence-answering.md and install it as a project skill at skills/evidence-answering/SKILL.md. Follow its Procedure. Do not modify Guardrails.
